data.name: Boston Dog Photography Class
data.headline: Capture Portraits and Action Shots of Your Dog
data.description:
#Boston Dog Photography Class
##*Capture portraits and action shots of your dog*

• **Adults:** $55
• **Youth (10-17):** $20
_________________________

If you’ve ever wanted to take pictures of your beloved dog that stand out, this PhotoWalks class is designed to show you the scenic locations in Beacon Hill and the Charles River Esplanade for the best shots.

Bring your smartphone or camera and learn how to:

*Pose your dog for portraits
*Capture playful action shots
*Take pictures that express your dog’s personality
*Use settings on your smartphone or camera to nail that shot!

Space is limited to 8. (One dog per person per reservation.)

Meeting Point: On the corner of Charles + Chestnut St.–outside Beacon Hill Hotel
data.cancellation_notes:
#Cancellation Policy#

Full refund or credit with at least 24 hours notice by customer.

Full refund or credit if a tour is canceled by PhotoWalks due to weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances. 

No refunds for no-shows.
data.booking_notes:
##Details

**Duration**
• 2 hours

**Meeting Point**
• On the corner of Charles + Chestnut Streets, outside Beacon Hill Hotel

**Train Stop**
• Arlington St(Green Line) or Park St (Red or Green Line)

The tour starts on time and your punctuality is appreciated. NOTE: If you are running late, please send a text to 617-851-2273 so you can meet up with the group. Phone calls will not be answered after a tour begins. 

**What to Bring**
• Camera or Smartphone
• Your cute dog (one per reservation)
• Dog treats, squeaky toys or small balls for action shots, water and leash
• Stylish pet outfit is optional
• Comfortable walking shoes for you
___________________________________
Please use the restroom prior to joining the tour. 

No smoking during the tour.
___________________________________
